versions.content: In each call of EthIf_MainFunctionTx the component shall call <EthDrv>_TxConfirmation for all Ethernet Controller Drivers. Note: The Ethernet Interface expects that each Ethernet Controller Driver issues con- firmations for all transmitted frames using the call-back function EthIf_TxConfir- mation .
